jobs.title: Client Service Manager (80 - 100%)

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire du service à la clientèle (80 - 100 %)

jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Client Service Manager (80 - 100%)

Olten |  Bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 8210

Möchtest du im internationalen Wertschriftengeschäft durchstarten?

Unser Client Desk Team – ein motivierter Mix aus jungen und erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden mit hohem Kundenfokus – freut sich auf eine kommunikationsstarke, teamfähige Persönlichkeit.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Bearbeitung und Koordination von Anfragen nationaler und internationaler Banken im Bereich Mandatory Cash Related Corporate Actions (Dividenden-, Zins- und Rückzahlungen) über alle relevanten Märkte hinweg

• Klärung von Entitlement-Fragen sowie Buchungs- und Zahlungsdifferenzen

• Abklärungen mit Banken, Custodians, CSDs, Paying Agents und weiteren Marktteilnehmern zur korrekten und termingerechten Abwicklung

• Recherchen über interne und externe Systeme, Datenquellen und Marktunterlagen

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen

• Bearbeitung von Kundeneskalationen sowie Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Prozessen und Servicequalität

Das bringst du mit

• Kaufmännische Ausbildung, Banklehre oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Idealerweise Erfahrung in Asset Servicing, Custody, Corporate Actions oder Securities Operations

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift auf Deutsch und Englisch (mind. B2)

• Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit analytischem Denken

• Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie professionelles Auftreten

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Responsabile Servizio Clienti (80 - 100%)

Olten | Fino al 40% Home Office possibile | Riferimento 8210

Vuoi iniziare nel settore dei titoli internazionali?

Il nostro team di desk clienti – un mix motivato di dipendenti giovani e esperti con un alto focus del cliente – non vede l'ora di una personalità forte e competente per il team.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Elaborazione e coordinamento delle richieste da parte delle banche nazionali e internazionali nell'ambito delle azioni societarie obbligatorie (dividendi, interessi e rimborsi) in tutti i mercati rilevanti

• Chiarificazione delle questioni di diritto e differenze di contabilità e di pagamento

• Reclami con banche, custodi, CSD, agenti paganti e altri partecipanti al mercato per un corretto e tempestivo insediamento

• Ricerca su sistemi interni ed esterni, fonti di dati e documenti di mercato

• Cooperazione con i dipartimenti interni

• Elaborazione di escalation del cliente e partecipazione all'ottimizzazione dei processi e della qualità dei servizi

Lo porti con te.

• Istruzione commerciale, titoli bancari o simili

• Idealmente, l'esperienza nella manutenzione degli asset, la custodia, le azioni aziendali o le operazioni di titoli

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in parola e scrittura in tedesco e inglese (min. B2)

• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione con il pensiero analitico

• forte orientamento del cliente e del servizio e l'aspetto professionale

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us forward: Between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Client Service Manager (80 - 100%)

Olten | Up to 40% Home Office possible | Reference 8210

Would you like to start in the international securities business?

Our client desk team – a motivated mix of young and experienced employees with a high customer focus – is looking forward to a strong, team-capable personality.

These are your tasks

• Processing and coordination of requests from national and international banks in the area of Mandatory Cash Related Corporate Actions (dividend, interest and repayments) across all relevant markets

• Clarification of entitlement issues as well as accounting and payment differences

• Claims with banks, custodians, CSDs, paying agents and other market participants for correct and timely settlement

• Research on internal and external systems, data sources and market documents

• Cooperation with internal departments

• Processing of customer escalations and participation in the optimization of processes and service quality

You bring that with you

• Commercial education, banking or similar qualifications

• Ideally, experience in asset servicing, custody, corporate actions or securities operations

• Excellent communication skills in word and writing in German and English (min. B2)

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method with analytical thinking

• Strong customer and service orientation as well as professional appearance

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska on +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

Notre équipe client – un mélange motivé d'employés jeunes et expérimentés avec une forte concentration client – est impatiente d'avoir une personnalité forte et capable d'équipe.

Ce sont vos tâches

• Traitement et coordination des demandes des banques nationales et internationales dans le domaine des actions d'entreprise obligatoires en espèces (dividende, intérêts et remboursements) sur tous les marchés pertinents

• Clarification des questions de droit ainsi que des différences de comptabilité et de paiement

• Créances auprès des banques, des dépositaires, des DCT, des agents payeurs et d'autres acteurs du marché en vue d'un règlement correct et rapide

• Recherche sur les systèmes internes et externes, les sources de données et les documents de marché

• Coopération avec les services internes

• Traitement de l'escalade des clients et participation à l'optimisation des processus et de la qualité du service

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Études commerciales, banques ou qualifications similaires

• Idéalement, l'expérience dans le service d'actifs, la garde, les actions d'entreprise ou les opérations en valeurs mobilières

• Excellente capacité de communication en allemand et en anglais (min. B2)

• Méthode de travail indépendante, structurée et orientée vers la solution avec réflexion analytique

• Une forte orientation client et service ainsi que l'apparence professionnelle

Si vous avez des questions, visitez notre page FAQ ou contactez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

La diversité est importante pour nous, donc nous accueillons favorablement les applications indépendamment de leurs antécédents personnels.

jobs.title: Working Student Customer Support 60-70%

titleByLocale.it: Supporto clienti degli studenti di lavoro 60-70 %

jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Working Student Customer Support 60-70%

Zurich |  60-70% | Referenz 8266

Du möchtest neben deinem Studium erste Berufserfahrungen sammeln und einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Qualität des Schweizer Finanzplatzes leisten? Du bist ein technologieaffines Organisationstalent mit ausgeprägten konzeptionellen Fähigkeiten? Dann freuen wir uns von dir zu hören! Du bist zuständig für die Überarbeitung und Aktualisierung unserer Wissensdatenbank, führst monatliche Statistiken und Auswertungen und unterstützt das Team in der Optimierung der Arbeitsabläufe.

Als modernes, dynamisches und innovatives Unternehmen bieten wir eine Vielzahl von Möglichkeiten, dein Potenzial in der spannenden Welt von Technologie und Finanzen zu entfalten. Wir unterstützen dich bei deinem Berufseinstieg, investieren in deine Entwicklung und die Erweiterung deiner persönlichen Fähigkeiten. Als «Working Student» bis du Teil unserer NextGen Community und bist Teil eines Netzwerks von engagierten Career Starter.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben

• Revision, Pflege und laufende Aktualisierung der Support-Wissensdatenbank in Confluence und SharePoint.

• Teilnahme an wiederkehrenden Meetings und entsprechende Nachbearbeitung (Support-EPICs, Prozessorganisation und -Dokumentation).

• Unterstützung des Teams bei verschiedenen Belangen mit Fokus auf der Optimierung der Arbeitsabläufe.

• Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen

• Erstellung und Pflege von Prozessdokumentationen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Richtlinien

Das bringst Du mit

• Aktuelles Studium (Bachelor oder Master) im Bereich Wirtschaft oder Informatik

• Technologieaffin sowie Interesse an digitalen Zahlungsmethoden

• Sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, Serviceorientierung, vernetztes Denken sowie Flexibilität und eine genaue Arbeitsweise

• Freude an der Arbeit im Team

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Janine Reichling  unter der Nummer +41 58 399 42 99.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Assistenza clienti per studenti di lavoro 60-70

Zurigo, 60-70, riferimento 8266

Vuoi acquisire la prima esperienza professionale e dare un contributo importante alla qualità del centro finanziario svizzero oltre ai tuoi studi? Sei un talento organizzativo tecnologico-affine con forti competenze concettuali? Allora siamo felici di sentir parlare da te! Sei responsabile della revisione e aggiornamento della nostra base di conoscenze, dello svolgimento di statistiche e valutazioni mensili e del supporto al team nell'ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro.

Come azienda moderna, dinamica e innovativa, offriamo una varietà di opportunità per sbloccare il tuo potenziale nel mondo emozionante della tecnologia e della finanza. Ti sosteniamo nel tuo ingresso nella carriera, investi nel tuo sviluppo e amplia le tue competenze personali. Come "Studente di lavoro" fino a quando non fai parte della nostra comunità NextGen e fai parte di una rete di starter dedicati alla carriera.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Revisione, manutenzione e aggiornamento continuo del database delle conoscenze di supporto in Confluence e SharePoint.

• Partecipazione a post-elaborazione ricorrente e corrispondente (sostenere EPIC, organizzazione di processo e documentazione).

• Sostenere il team in vari problemi con un focus sull'ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro.

• Supporto nell'analisi dei processi aziendali

• Preparazione e manutenzione della documentazione di processo, istruzioni di lavoro e linee guida

Porta questo con te

• Studi attuali (Bachelor o Master) in economia o informatica

• Tecnologia e interesse per i metodi di pagamento digitali

• Ottime competenze analitiche e concettuali, orientamento ai servizi, pensiero in rete, flessibilità e precisi metodi di lavoro

• Godere di lavorare in squadra

• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in termini di parole e scrittura

Per qualsiasi domanda, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Janine Reichling al +41 58 399 42 99.

Per questa vacanza si tiene conto solo delle domande dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi siamo felici delle applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.

• Support the team in various issues with a focus on optimizing workflows.

• Support in the analysis of business processes

• Preparation and maintenance of process documentation, working instructions and guidelines

You bring this with you

• Current studies (Bachelor or Master) in economics or computer science

• Technology-related and interest in digital payment methods

• Very good analytical and conceptual skills, service orientation, networked thinking, flexibility and precise working methods

• Enjoying working in the team

• Very good German and English knowledge in word and writing

If you have any questions, please visit our FAQ page or contact Janine Reichling at +41 58 399 42 99.

jobs.title: AI Software Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Software Architect

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8259

Shape and execute the AI SDLC at SIX · reports to Head of Software Engineering Practices

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. As AI Software Architect, you will set the technical direction for this shift: designing the reference patterns, tooling, and quality gates that make AI-augmented and agentic development safe and effective in a regulated financial market infrastructure, and driving adoption across teams you don't manage.

What You Will Do

• Translate the AI software engineering strategy into working practice. Design, prototype and harden the reference patterns, tooling and reusable components that make AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) real across SIX.

• Set the deepest technical standards for AI-based development: prompt and agent patterns, code review of AI-generated code, and the quality and security gates that make it safe in a regulated FMI.

• Support and execute the people transformation journey, evolving developer roles, team structures, processes and ways of working to unlock the full potential of AI-augmented software engineering

• Run lighthouse engagements hands-on: understand the process of business-unit software teams, baseline and measure impact on real backlogs, and prove value before scaling.

• Drive adoption across teams you don't manage. Coach senior engineers, win over skeptics, and lead the community of practice across CH, ES, PL and IN.

What You Bring

• 8+ years in software engineering with deep with current hands-on expertise across the entire SDLC. You still design software systems, write and review code, and engineers trust your technical judgment.

• Strong systems and architecture thinking across the end-to-end SDLC, and sound judgment on putting AI into a regulated, business-critical environment

• Hands-on experience with AI harness, LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including building custom workflows when off-the-shelf falls short. Claude Code hands-on experience in production is a plus.

• A track record of driving change through influence, not authority. You've won over skeptical senior engineers and spread practice across teams you didn't manage.

• Excellent stakeholder management, low ego and a teaching instinct — equally credible in a design review with a principal engineer and a risk conversation with security; fluent in English, German a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

AI Software Architetto

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8259

Formare ed eseguire il SDLC AI a SIX · rapporti a capo delle pratiche di ingegneria del software

Agentic AI sta cambiando come il software viene costruito — e a SIX, toccherà il lavoro di più di mille ingegneri. Come AI Software Architect, si imposta la direzione tecnica per questo cambiamento: progettare i modelli di riferimento, strumenti e cancelli di qualità che rendono lo sviluppo AI-augmented e agentic sicuro ed efficace in un'infrastruttura di mercato finanziario regolamentata, e guidare l'adozione in team che non gestisci.

• Traduire les besoins des entreprises, des risques et de la réglementation en exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles claires, en modèles de processus, en histoires d'utilisateurs et en critères d'acceptation.

• Former et développer les capacités et les modèles de gouvernance de l'IAM à l'échelle de la main-d'oeuvre IAM, les services en nuage, les identités non humaines, y compris les agents de l'IA, ainsi que le contrôle d'accès fondé sur les politiques, transformant les besoins émergents en processus évolutifs et en concepts de solutions réalisables.

• Élaborer des solutions pour SailPoint IdentityIQ en évaluant les capacités de la plateforme, en définissant les flux de travail et les flux de données et en alignant les concepts avec les ingénieurs et les architectes de l'IAM.

• Analyser les données de l'IAM afin d'identifier les tendances, les causes profondes, les lacunes de contrôle et les possibilités d'automatisation, et présenter des recommandations fondées sur des données probantes.

• Faire le pont entre les parties prenantes et l'équipe de distribution, en soutenant la hiérarchisation, la mise en œuvre, l'essai, le déploiement et l'adoption de solutions durables de MEI.

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en tant qu'analyste d'affaires de l'IAM, ingénieur des exigences ou consultant en l'IAM, avec une solide connaissance de l'IAM et de l'IGA, gouvernance d'accès, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, ingénierie des rôles, certifications, séparation des fonctions et exigences de contrôle pertinentes; expérience avec les aspects de l'IAM des services cloud ou des agents d'IA est un avantage.

• Connaissance pratique de SailPoint IIQ/ISC et bonne compréhension des systèmes et de l'architecture des applications, y compris la façon dont les systèmes d'entreprise fonctionnent ensemble.

• Expérience éprouvée de l'ingénierie des besoins, de la modélisation des processus et du cycle de vie du développement logiciel, avec suffisamment de connaissances techniques pour évaluer la faisabilité, comprendre les approches de mise en œuvre et contester de manière constructive les propositions techniques.

• Forte capacité d'analyse et de données, y compris les outils SQL et BI (Python est un avantage), avec la capacité de transformer l'information complexe en décisions saines et des recommandations claires.

• Compétences de communication et de facilitation confidentielles avec les intervenants techniques et non techniques en anglais; l'allemand est un avantage, combiné avec l'orientation client, la propriété et l'attention aux détails.

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% möglich | Referenz 8043

Der Head of Business Development & Strategy gestaltet und liefert die Wachstumsagenda von SIX Securities Services. Die Rolle treibt transversale strategische Initiativen, neue Unternehmensgründungen, Partnerschaften und M&A-Möglichkeiten voran und stellt sicher, dass BSS als führender europäischer Post-Trade-Infrastrukturanbieter positioniert ist.

Sie ist über alle vertikalen Produktbereiche hinweg tätig und übersetzt die Strategie in die Umsetzung, erschließt neue Umsatzmöglichkeiten und unterstützt Führungskräfte bei der Steuerung der langfristigen Entwicklung des Geschäftsbereichs.

Was Sie tun werden

• Strategische Umsetzung vorantreiben: Übersetzen Sie die BSS-Strategie in klare Roadmaps, um disziplinierte Umsetzung, Risikomanagement und messbare Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

• Wachstumschancen identifizieren und liefern: Erweitern Sie Umsatzströme in den Bereichen Clearing, Depot, Wertpapierfinanzierung und Mehrwertdienste, einschließlich neuer Märkte und Kundensegmente.

• Führen Sie Partnerschaften und M&A-Initiativen: Entwickeln Sie strategische Partnerschaften und verwalten Sie anorganische Wachstumschancen von der Bewertung bis zur Integration.

• Beratung von Führungskräften: Bereitstellung strategischer Erkenntnisse, Business Cases und Performance Monitoring zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung auf Führungsebene.

• Gewährleistung einer funktionsübergreifenden Ausrichtung: Förderung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Geschäftsbereichen und Stärkung der Positionierung von SIX bei Kunden und im Kapitalmarkt-Ökosystem.

Was du mitbringst

• Umfangreiche Strategie- und Führungserfahrung: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in Unternehmensstrategie, Beratung oder Geschäftsentwicklung in Finanzmarktinfrastrukturen oder Kapitalmärkten.

• Starke Ausführungsorientierung: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Strategie in umsetzbare Prioritäten zu übersetzen und große Initiativen mit messbarer Wirkung zu liefern.

• Tiefe Branchenexpertise: Solides Verständnis von Nachhandelsdienstleistungen, Marktinfrastrukturdynamik und regulatorischem Umfeld.

• Erfahrung in Partnerschaften und M&A: Hands-on Exposition gegenüber strategischen Partnerschaften und anorganischem Wachstum, einschließlich Business Case Entwicklung und Integrationsplanung.

• Einfluss- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Fähigkeit, hochrangige Stakeholder glaubwürdig zu engagieren und zu beraten; fließend Englisch (Deutsch ist ein großer Vorteil).

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Chef Stratégie et développement des entreprises Services de valeurs mobilières

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible

Le responsable du développement des entreprises et de la stratégie définit et fournit le programme de croissance de SIX Securities Services. Ce rôle est à l'origine d'initiatives stratégiques transversales, de nouvelles créations d'entreprises, de partenariats et de possibilités de fusions et acquisitions, ce qui permet à BSS de se positionner comme un fournisseur d'infrastructure post-négociation européen de premier plan.

Fonctionnant sur toutes les verticales de produits, elle traduit la stratégie en exécution, ouvre de nouvelles possibilités de revenus et aide les cadres supérieurs à diriger le développement à long terme de l'unité opérationnelle.

Ce que vous ferez

• Diriger l'exécution stratégique : Traduire la stratégie de SSC en feuilles de route claires, en assurant une prestation disciplinée, la gestion des risques et des résultats mesurables.

• Identifier et offrir des possibilités de croissance : Élargir les flux de revenus entre les services de compensation, de garde, de financement des valeurs mobilières et de valeur ajoutée, y compris les nouveaux marchés et les segments de clients.

• Diriger les partenariats et les initiatives de S et A : Élaborer des partenariats stratégiques et gérer les possibilités de croissance inorganique, de l'évaluation à l'intégration.

• Conseiller les cadres supérieurs : Fournir des conseils stratégiques, des analyses de rentabilisation et une surveillance du rendement pour appuyer la prise de décisions au niveau des cadres supérieurs.

• Assurer l'alignement interfonctionnel : favoriser la collaboration entre les unités commerciales et renforcer le positionnement de SIX avec les clients et au sein de l'écosystème des marchés financiers.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience approfondie en matière de stratégie et de leadership : Expérience éprouvée en matière de stratégie d'entreprise, de consultation ou de développement d'entreprise au sein des infrastructures des marchés financiers ou des marchés de capitaux.

• Forte concentration sur l'exécution : Capacité démontrée de traduire la stratégie en priorités réalisables et de réaliser des initiatives à grande échelle ayant un impact mesurable.

• Expertise approfondie de l'industrie : Compréhension solide des services post-négociation, de la dynamique des infrastructures de marché et de l'environnement réglementaire.

• Expérience des partenariats et des fusions-acquisitions : Exposition directe aux partenariats stratégiques et à la croissance inorganique, y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation et la planification de l'intégration.

• Influence et compétences en communication : Capacité d'engager et de conseiller les principaux intervenants avec crédibilité; maîtrise de l'anglais (l'allemand est un fort avantage).

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 .

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior System Engineer

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8096

Do you want to define and govern how cryptographic keys are secured across a financial enterprise? Are you motivated by combining security, risk, and regulatory requirements into real control frameworks?

Join SIX as a Key Management Security Officer and take ownership of key management governance, ensuring secure and auditable cryptographic controls across critical platforms.

What You Will Do

• Define and enforce key management policies, standards, and controls

• Oversee the full lifecycle of cryptographic keys (generation to destruction)

• Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks (PCI DSS, FINMA, DORA)

• Support audits and maintain evidence for control traceability

• Assess risks and define mitigation measures for key management environments

What You Bring

• Strong knowledge of cryptography and key lifecycle management

• Experience with HSMs and key management platforms (e.g., Keyfactor, cloud KMS,Securesys,Thales,Entrust)

• Proven background in audit, compliance, or regulated environments

• Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills

• Degree in information security or related field; certifications (CISSP, CISM) are a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

• Definieren und Erzwingen wichtiger Managementrichtlinien, Standards und Kontrollen
• Überwachen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus kryptographischer Schlüssel (Generation bis Zerstörung)
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen (PCI DSS, FINMA, DORA)
• Unterstützung von Audits und Pflege von Nachweisen für die Rückverfolgbarkeit von Kontrollen
• Bewertung von Risiken und Festlegung von Minderungsmaßnahmen für wichtige Managementumgebungen Was du mitbringst
• Starkes Wissen über Kryptographie und Key Lifecycle Management
• Erfahrung mit HSMs und Key Management Plattformen (z.B. Keyfactor, Cloud KMS,Securesys, Thales, Entrust)
• Nachgewiesener Hintergrund in Audit-, Compliance- oder regulierten Umgebungen
• Starke analytische und Stakeholder Management Fähigkeiten
• Abschluss in Informationssicherheit oder verwandten Bereichen; Zertifizierungen (CISSP, CISM) sind ein Plus Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Mateusz Kozielec unter +41583998611 an. jobs.title: Head Fraud Services (100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Fraud Services (100%)

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Reference 8286

Möchtest du die Sicherheit im Kartengeschäft aktiv mitgestalten und zwei Teams führen, die Betrugsfälle bearbeiten sowie Fraud-Risiken frühzeitig erkennen und wirksam begrenzen? Dann übernimm die Leitung unserer Teams Fraud Services (Monitoring) und Fraud Intelligence.

Als Head Fraud Services verantwortest du die fachliche und personelle Führung der Teams Fraud Services (Monitoring)  und Fraud Intelligence. Du stellst einen zuverlässigen operativen Betrieb sicher, steuerst die Weiterentwicklung der Fraud Detection und Prevention und förderst die Zusammenarbeit mit internen sowie externen Partnern.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Fachliche und personelle Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung der Teams Fraud Services und Fraud Intelligence

• Sicherstellung des operativen Fraud Monitorings, der Bearbeitung von Betrugsverdachtsfällen und des Fraud Incident Managements

• Steuerung der Analyse neuer Fraud-Trends sowie der Definition, Priorisierung und Wirksamkeitsmessung geeigneter Gegenmassnahmen

• Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung des Rule Managements, der Fraud Prevention Prozesse sowie der relevanten Reports und KPIs

• Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Schemes, Behörden sowie internen und externen Partnern und Vertretung des Bereichs in relevanten Gremien

• Fraud Incident Management bei Fraud Attacken

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder höhere Weiterbildung mit ausgewiesener Berufserfahrung im Finanz- oder Kartengeschäft

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Fraud Management, vorzugsweise im Bereich Debitkarten und TWINT.

• Führungserfahrung sowie die Fähigkeit, Teams zielorientiert zu entwickeln und Veränderungen wirksam umzusetzen

• Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten verbunden mit einer strukturierten, qualitätsorientierten Arbeitsweise

• Klare und professionelle Kommunikation sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8237

Are you passionate about secure web access, identity, and modern authentication technologies? Then our Web Access Management team wants to hear from you. We are a collaborative and security-focused team responsible for protecting access to business-critical web applications and APIs. Our goal is to provide stable, secure, and continuously improving access services across reverse proxy, web application firewall, and customer identity platforms. In this role, you will work closely with application teams, security architects, platform engineers, and service owners to design, operate, and enhance secure access patterns in a regulated environment.

What You Will Do

• Operate and enhance Web Access Management services, including reverse proxy, access gateway, web application firewall, and customer identity components.

• Design, build, and troubleshoot secure authentication and single sign-on flows based on OpenID Connect, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0.

• Configure routing, TLS certificates, access policies, authorization mappings, and upstream integrations for web applications and APIs.

• Tune and maintain web application firewall policies, including OWASP Core Rule Set handling, exceptions, anomaly scoring, and change control.

• Contribute to operational stability, automation, monitoring, incident response, upgrades, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous service improvement.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on knowledge of reverse proxy or access gateway platforms, including TLS handling, routing, header and cookie management, session handling, and high-availability operations.

• Practical experience with web application firewall technologies, ModSecurity, OWASP Core Rule Set, rule tuning, false-positive handling, and secure publishing patterns.

• Solid understanding of customer identity and access management, identity lifecycle, multi-factor authentication, secure account recovery, token validation, and authorization models.

• Good knowledge of federation and access protocols such as OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SAML 2.0, JWT, PKCE, scopes, claims, certificates, metadata, and key rotation.

• Analytical, security-minded, and collaborative working style, with good communication skills; fluent English is required, German is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Descriptif

SIX est le moteur de la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous fait avancer : entre racines locales et importance mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d’avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les incitons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l’avenir des marchés financiers avec nous.

Services spécialisés de vote par procuration (80-100 %)

Olten | Jusqu'à 40 % de bureau à domicile possible | Référence 8235

Êtes-vous à la recherche d'un défi passionnant dans un environnement de travail dynamique? Souhaitez-vous assumer la responsabilité de la coordination et du traitement du vote par procuration mondial ?

Alors notre équipe Proxy Voting International serait heureuse d’avoir de vos nouvelles !
Notre équipe est en contact quotidien avec nos clients et les accompagne pour toutes les questions relatives au vote par procuration. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable du traitement en temps opportun des instructions de vote internationales et soutiendrez nos clients avec un service spécialisé d'importance réglementaire croissante.
Nous prenons votre avis et vous très au sérieux et comptons sur votre expérience pour répondre aux exigences de nos clients exigeants et pour améliorer et développer continuellement notre offre.

Tâches

- Traitement des instructions de vote globales et des tickets d'assemblée générale
- Suivi des délais, des exceptions et des cas particuliers comme le vote tardif
- Répondre aux demandes des clients et coordonner avec les dépositaires, les prestataires et les interfaces internes
- Coordination des demandes de divulgation dans le cadre des exigences réglementaires, par ex. Par ex. SRD II
- Collaborer aux améliorations des processus et aux projets ayant un impact sur le service de vote par procuration

Exigences

- Formation commerciale de base complétée ou formation équivalente, idéalement liée aux services financiers ou aux services réglementés
- Expérience professionnelle dans des environnements de finance, de valeurs mobilières, d'opérations ou de service à la clientèle ; Une connaissance du vote par procuration, des opérations sur titres, de la conservation ou des opérations sur titres est un plus
- Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais, parlés et écrits
- Manière structurée et fiable de travailler avec un souci des risques, des délais et des détails
- Apprécier le contact client, le travail d'équipe et le développement ultérieur des processus

Contacter

Si vous avez des questions, visitez notre page FAQ ou contactez Julia Schmidt au 41583998670.

Pour ce poste vacant, nous ne considérons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous, c'est pourquoi nous acceptons les candidatures quel que soit votre parcours personnel.

jobs.title: Incident & Problem Manager (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Incident & Problem Manager (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% Home office possible | Reference 8293

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? Are you motivated to ensure reliable services and trusted communication for Swiss banks during critical situations? We are looking for a Business Incident Manager to join our BBS Operations team in Zurich, responsible for managing incidents from a business perspective, ensuring clear communication, and supporting continuous improvement. Be part of a team that values reliability, collaboration, and ownership in delivering stable and customer-oriented services.

What You Will Do

• assess incidents from a business and client impact view, complementing technical handling by control center teams

• ensure clear and timely communication, preparing incident updates and reports for clients and internal stakeholders

• coordinate follow-up actions and support transition to problem management, ensuring proper documentation and closure

• act as interface between operations, IT teams and external providers during incidents to align priorities and actions

• participate in 7×24 on-call duty, supporting business-critical incidents outside standard working hours

What You Bring

• experience with IT service management frameworks such as ITIL or similar structured incident processes

• strong understanding of service operations and business processes; additional experience in payments or transaction processing environments is a plus

• ability to structure complex information and communicate clearly to different stakeholder groups

• high level of ownership and accountability when handling critical situations and time-sensitive incidents

• needed Language Skills: English and German (spoken and written)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8241

Do you want to design, build, and operate reliable, scalable systems powering financial index services? Are you passionate about hands-on engineering and solving complex technical challenges in a distributed environment?

Our Index team is based in Zurich and India and develops core platforms that enable the creation, calculation, and distribution of financial indices. We work at the intersection of data, engineering, and financial markets, ensuring stable and high-quality services for internal and external stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a senior individual contributor within this distributed setup, working closely with engineers in Zurich and India. You will combine deep hands-on engineering expertise with end-to-end technical ownership, shaping robust solutions from design through production. You will collaborate closely with product managers, domain experts, SRE teams, and other engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable, and effective systems.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python for index calculation and data processing platforms

• Own the end-to-end delivery of features, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet quality expectations

• Take technical ownership of complex components and features, from solution design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support

• Collaborate with SRE teams to ensure systems are reliable and production-ready, contributing to improvements where needed

• Drive architecture and engineering decisions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability

What You Bring

• Deep hands-on software engineering expertise with Java (Spring Boot) and Python, including building, testing, deploying, and supporting production services

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and make sound architecture and engineering decisions in production environments

• Strong knowledge of backend and distributed system design, including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, and maintainable integration patterns

• Experience using modern engineering tooling and AI-assisted development to improve productivity and code quality

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience in building and operating production systems

• Fluent English communication skills; German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

titleByLocale.fr: Ventes et produits de stages - Marchés primaires

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Internship Sales & Products - Primary Markets

Zurich |  100% | Reference 8320

To support our Sales & Products and Primary Markets teams, we are looking for a highly motivated Intern (100%) for a fixed six-month period from 1 January 2027 to 30 June 2027.

Are you eager to gain first-hand experience at the Swiss Stock Exchange in a dynamic and collaborative environment? Do you want to develop your professional skills while working closely with clients, listed companies, and market participants? If so, this internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain valuable insights into the financial markets industry.

As part of our Sales & Products team, you will gain practical experience across a range of asset classes, including Equities, Fixed Income, ETFs, and Structured Products. In addition, you will work closely with our Primary Markets team, where you will gain exposure to listed companies, capital markets activities, and the IPO process. We look forward to receiving your CV and motivation letter.

What You Will Do

• Deliver the weekly market commentary to the Global Sales & Products team

• Prepare client presentations for Relationship Managers and Sales Managers, and participate in client calls and meetings

• Maintain and update Global Account Plans for key strategic client relationships

• Prepare and distribute qualitative and quantitative business statistics to clients

• Conduct market and competitor research to support the development of targeted sales strategies

• Support the preparation of and participate in meetings with listed companies, trading firms, and other market participants

• Assist in the planning and execution of internal and external events

What You Bring

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Banking, Economics, or a related field, ideally complemented by initial practical experience in Swiss banking, financial markets, or a comparable environment

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Excel

• Structured, detail-oriented, and results-driven working style with a strong commitment to quality

• Self-motivated, proactive, and collaborative personality who enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in both German and English

• Availability between 1 January 2027 to 30 June 2027 (fixed internship period: 6 months)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Janine Reichling  at +41 58 399 42 99 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Zurigo | 100% | Riferimento 8320

Sei impaziente di acquisire esperienza di prima mano presso la Borsa Svizzera in un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo? Vuoi sviluppare le tue competenze professionali lavorando a stretto contatto con i clienti, le aziende quotate e i partecipanti al mercato? Se è così, questo tirocinio offre un'ottima opportunità per ottenere preziose informazioni sull'industria dei mercati finanziari.

Nell'ambito del nostro team Sales & Products, acquisirai esperienza pratica in una gamma di classi di asset, tra cui Equities, Fixed Income, ETF e Structured Products. Inoltre, lavorerai a stretto contatto con il nostro team di Primary Markets, dove potrai ottenere l'esposizione a società quotate, attività sui mercati dei capitali e il processo IPO. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere il tuo CV e la lettera di motivazione.

Cosa farai

• Consegna il commento settimanale del mercato al team Global Sales & Products

• Preparare le presentazioni dei clienti per Relationship Manager e Sales Manager, e partecipare a chiamate e riunioni dei clienti

• Mantenere e aggiornare Piani di conto globali per le relazioni strategiche dei clienti

• Preparare e distribuire statistiche aziendali qualitative e quantitative ai clienti

• Condurre il mercato e la ricerca concorrente per sostenere lo sviluppo di strategie di vendita mirate

• Sostenere la preparazione e la partecipazione a riunioni con società quotate, società di trading e altri partecipanti al mercato

• Assistere nella progettazione ed esecuzione di eventi interni ed esterni

Che cosa porta

• Corso di laurea o Master in Business Administration, Finanza, Banking, Economia o un campo correlato, idealmente completato da esperienza pratica iniziale nel settore bancario, finanziario svizzero, o un ambiente paragonabile

• Forte competenza nelle applicazioni Microsoft Office, in particolare PowerPoint ed Excel

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientato al dettaglio e orientato ai risultati con un forte impegno nella qualità

• Personalità automotivata, proattiva e collaborativa che gode di lavorare in un ambiente veloce e dinamico

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con fluidità sia in tedesco che in inglese

• Disponibilità dal 1° gennaio 2027 al 30 giugno 2027 (periodo di tirocinio fisso: 6 mesi)

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Janine Reichling al numero +41 58 399 42 99 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Internship Sales & Products - Primary Markets

Zurich | 100% | Reference 8320

To support our Sales & Products and Primary Markets teams, we are looking for a highly motivated Intern (100%) for a fixed six-month period from 1 January 2027 to 30 June 2027.

Are you eager to gain first-hand experience at the Swiss Stock Exchange in a dynamic and collaborative environment? Do you want to develop your professional skills while working closely with clients, listed companies, and market participants? If so, this internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain valuable insights into the financial markets industry.

As part of our Sales & Products team, you will gain practical experience across a range of asset classes, including Equities, Fixed Income, ETFs, and Structured Products. In addition, you will work closely with our Primary Markets team, where you will gain exposure to listed companies, capital markets activities, and the IPO process. We look forward to receiving your CV and motivation letter.

What You Will Do

• Deliver the weekly market commentary to the Global Sales & Products team

• Prepare client presentations for Relationship Managers and Sales Managers, and participate in client calls and meetings

• Maintain and update Global Account Plans for key strategic client relationships

• Prepare and distribute qualitative and quantitative business statistics to clients

• Conduct market and competitor research to support the development of targeted sales strategies

• Support the preparation of and participate in meetings with listed companies, trading firms, and other market participants

• Assist in the planning and execution of internal and external events

What You Bring

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Banking, Economics, or a related field, ideally complemented by initial practical experience in Swiss banking, financial markets, or a comparable environment

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Excel

• Structured, detail-oriented, and results-driven working style with a strong commitment to quality

• Self-motivated, proactive, and collaborative personality who enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in both German and English

• Availability between 1 January 2027 to 30 June 2027 (fixed internship period: 6 months)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Janine Reichling at +41 58 399 42 99 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Praktikum Sales & Products - Primärmärkte

Zürich | 100% | Referenz 8320

Möchten Sie an der Schweizer Börse in einem dynamischen und kollaborativen Umfeld Erfahrungen aus erster Hand sammeln? Als Teil unseres Sales & Products Teams sammeln Sie praktische Erfahrungen in einer Reihe von Anlageklassen, darunter Aktien, Fixed Income, ETFs und Strukturierte Produkte. Was Sie tun werden

• Liefern Sie den wöchentlichen Marktkommentar an das Global Sales & Products Team

• Bereiten Sie Kundenpräsentationen für Relationship Manager und Sales Manager vor und nehmen Sie an Kundenanrufen und Meetings teil

• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie Global Account Pläne für wichtige strategische Kundenbeziehungen

• Erstellung und Verteilung qualitativer und quantitativer Unternehmensstatistiken an Kunden

• Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerberforschung zur Unterstützung der Entwicklung gezielter Verkaufsstrategien

• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung und Teilnahme an Treffen mit börsennotierten Unternehmen, Handelsunternehmen und anderen Marktteilnehmern

• Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung interner und externer Veranstaltungen

Was du mitbringst

• Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finanzen, Bankwesen, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich, ideal ergänzt durch erste praktische Erfahrungen im Schweizer Bankwesen, auf den Finanzmärkten oder in einem vergleichbaren Umfeld

• Starke Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel

• Strukturierter, detailorientierter und ergebnisorientierter Arbeitsstil mit starkem Engagement für Qualität

• Selbstmotivierte, proaktive und kollaborative Persönlichkeit, die gerne in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Umfeld arbeitet

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit fließendem Deutsch und Englisch

• Verfügbarkeit zwischen dem 1. Januar 2027 und dem 30. Juni 2027 (feste Praktikumszeit: 6 Monate)

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Ventes et produits de stages - Marchés primaires

Zurich (100%) Référence 8320

Pour soutenir nos équipes Ventes & Produits et Marchés Primaires, nous recherchons un stagiaire hautement motivé (100%) pour une période fixe de six mois allant du 1er janvier 2027 au 30 juin 2027.

Souhaitez-vous acquérir une expérience de première main à la Bourse suisse dans un environnement dynamique et collaboratif ? Voulez-vous développer vos compétences professionnelles tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les clients, les entreprises cotées et les participants au marché? Si c'est le cas, ce stage offre une excellente occasion d'acquérir des connaissances précieuses sur l'industrie des marchés financiers.

Dans le cadre de notre équipe Ventes & Produits, vous acquerrez une expérience pratique dans une gamme de classes d'actifs, y compris les actions, les revenus fixes, les ETF et les produits structurés. De plus, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre équipe des marchés primaires, où vous serez exposés aux sociétés cotées, aux activités des marchés de capitaux et au processus d'EPO. Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre CV et votre lettre de motivation.

Ce que vous ferez

• Livrez le commentaire hebdomadaire du marché à l'équipe Global Sales & Products

• Préparer les présentations des clients pour les gestionnaires des relations et les gestionnaires des ventes, et participer aux appels et réunions des clients

• Maintenir et mettre à jour les plans de comptes mondiaux pour les principales relations stratégiques avec les clients

• Préparer et distribuer des statistiques qualitatives et quantitatives sur les entreprises aux clients

• Mener des recherches sur le marché et les concurrents pour appuyer l'élaboration de stratégies de vente ciblées

• Appuyer la préparation et la participation à des réunions avec des sociétés cotées, des sociétés commerciales et d'autres participants au marché

• Aider à la planification et à l'exécution des événements internes et externes

Ce que vous apportez

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en administration des affaires, finance, banque, économie, ou un domaine connexe, idéalement complété par une expérience pratique initiale dans les banques suisses, les marchés financiers ou un environnement comparable

• Forte maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office, en particulier PowerPoint et Excel

• Style de travail structuré, axé sur les détails et axé sur les résultats, avec un engagement ferme envers la qualité

• Personnalité automotivée, proactive et collaborative qui aime travailler dans un environnement dynamique et rapide

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, avec maîtrise en allemand et en anglais

• Disponibilité entre le 1er janvier 2027 et le 30 juin 2027 (période de stage fixe: 6 mois)

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Janine Reichling au +41 58 399 42 99 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: IT Workplace Support Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich |  100 | Reference 7978

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site. Please note that the role is 100% ofiice-based.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich | 100 | Reference 7978

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site. Please note that the role is 100% ofiice-based.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

jobs.title: Specialist Settlement (80%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Settlement (80%)

Olten, Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 7912

Hast du Freude daran, komplexe Finanzprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und sicherzustellen, dass auch Ausnahme-Situationen effizient gelöst werden? Das Team Settlement Special Services gewährleistet zentrale Dienstleistungen rund um die Wertschriftenabwicklung bei SIX SIS. Im Bereich Exception Handling übernehmen wir die Überwachung und Verarbeitung aller non-STP-Swift-Meldungen sowie verschiedener Kontrollreports. Mit einer proaktiven Steuerung unserer Prozesse und Risiken stellen wir einen zuverlässigen Betrieb und einen hohen Servicelevel sicher.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine(n) SpezialistIn Settlement, die/der Lust auf abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, Verantwortung und ein dynamisches Umfeld mitbringt. Wir bieten dir eine spannende, vielseitige Position mit bis zu 40% Homeoffice. Mindestens drei Arbeitstage pro Woche verbringst du im Büro – wahlweise in Zürich oder Olten. Ein gemeinsamer Teamtag pro Woche findet fix in Olten statt.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Koordination und Kommunikation mit internen und externen Schnittstellen, darunter Network Management, Depotstellen in verschiedenen Ländern, ICSDs, CSDs, Client Relationship Manager, Corporate Actions, Valorenstammdaten und Reconciliation

• Zeitgerechte Verarbeitung von non-STP Swift-Nachrichten (MT54x) von über 50 Ländern

• Investigation und Korrekturverbuchung von Reconciliationbreaks

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Abwicklungsabläufe sowie Pflege und Weiterentwicklung

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung; idealerweise mit Banklehre oder vergleichbarer Qualifikation

• Fundiertes Fachwissen im Wertschriftenbereich, sowie praktische Erfahrung im Tagesgeschäft; mehrjährige Erfahrung im Settlement ist wünschenswert

• Teamorientierte, engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Eigeninitiative und klarer, adressatengerechter Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie hohe Zuverlässigkeit und ein starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci rende diversi ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Regolazione specialistica (80%)

Olten, Zurich | Fino al 40% di sede possibile | Riferimento 7912

Ti piace modellare attivamente processi finanziari complessi e garantire che situazioni eccezionali siano risolte in modo efficiente? Il team Settlement Special Services garantisce servizi centralizzati di elaborazione titoli presso SIX SIS. Nell'ambito della gestione delle eccezioni, siamo responsabili del monitoraggio e dell'elaborazione di tutti i messaggi non-STP-Swift e di vari rapporti di controllo. Controllando proattivamente i nostri processi e rischi, garantiamo un funzionamento affidabile e un alto livello di servizio.

Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando uno specialista in Settlement che ha il desiderio di diversi compiti, responsabilità e un ambiente dinamico. Vi offriamo una posizione emozionante e versatile con fino al 40% ufficio domestico. Trascorrete almeno tre giorni lavorativi a settimana in ufficio – a Zurigo o Olten. Una giornata di squadra congiunta a settimana si svolge a Olten.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Coordinamento e comunicazione con interfacce interne ed esterne, tra cui gestione della rete, uffici di custodia in diversi paesi, ICSD, CSD, responsabili delle relazioni con i clienti, azioni aziendali, dati master e riconciliazione

• Elaborazione tempestiva di messaggi non-STP Swift (MT54x) da oltre 50 paesi

• Indagine e correzione delle rotture di riconciliazione

• Ottimizzazione continua dei processi di lavorazione, manutenzione e ulteriore sviluppo

Lo porti con te.

• Formazione commerciale di base completata; idealmente con qualificazione bancaria o comparabile

• Competenza approfondita nel settore dei titoli, nonché esperienza pratica nel business quotidiano; diversi anni di esperienza nel regolamento è auspicabile

• Personalità orientata al team, impegnata con forte iniziativa e chiare capacità di comunicazione orientate al destinatario

• Metodo di lavoro analitico e strutturato, comprensione rapida e alta affidabilità e un forte senso di responsabilità

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What makes us different drives us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Specialist Settlement (80%)

Olten, Zurich | up to 40% home office possible | Reference 7912

Do you enjoy actively shaping complex financial processes and ensuring that exceptional situations are also solved efficiently? The Settlement Special Services team ensures centralised securities processing services at SIX SIS. In the area of exception handling, we are responsible for monitoring and processing all non-STP-Swift messages as well as various control reports. By proactively controlling our processes and risks, we ensure reliable operation and a high level of service.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a specialist in Settlement who has a desire for varied tasks, responsibility and a dynamic environment. We offer you an exciting, versatile position with up to 40% home office. You spend at least three working days per week in the office – either in Zurich or Olten. A joint team day per week takes place in Olten.

These are your tasks

• Coordination and communication with internal and external interfaces, including network management, custodian offices in different countries, ICSDs, CSDs, client relationship managers, corporate actions, valor master data and reconciliation

• Timely processing of non-STP Swift messages (MT54x) from over 50 countries

• Investigation and correction of reconciliation breaks

• Continuous optimization of processing processes as well as maintenance and further development

You bring that with you

• Basic commercial training completed; ideally with banking or comparable qualification

• In-depth expertise in the field of securities, as well as practical experience in day-to-day business; several years of experience in the settlement is desirable

• Team-oriented, committed personality with strong initiative and clear, addressee-oriented communication skills

• Analytical and structured working method, fast comprehension as well as high reliability and a strong sense of responsibility

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska on +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

Olten, Zurich: jusqu'à 40% de bureau à domicile possible

jobs.description:

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Payment Specialist (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office moeglich | Referenz 8193

Du möchtest unser Team im SIC Operations unterstützen und einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Qualität des Schweizer Finanzplatzes leisten? Dann freuen wir uns von dir zu hören. Viele Änderungen im Zahlungsverkehr müssen auch unsere Teilnehmer (Banken in der Schweiz und ganz Europa) rechtzeitig umsetzen. In dieser Funktion bist du die Überwachungs- und Anlaufzentrale für Support-Anfragen in Bezug zum elektronischen Zahlungsverkehr. Du arbeitest im Schichtbetrieb (Montag bis Freitag zwischen 06.30 – 19.30 Uhr) inkl. Pikett Einsätze (nach 1 Jahr) ausserhalb der Bürozeiten. Weiterhin hast du die Möglichkeit, in diversen Projekten mitzuarbeiten. Für diese abwechslungsreiche und spannende Position bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell (SIX Office & Home Office) an.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• 1st und 2nd Level Support für den Schweizerischen Zahlungsverkehr (SIC – inkl. Instant Payments – und euroSIC)

• Überwachung der Zahlungssysteme (SIC/euroSIC/SWIFT) und der technischen Verbindungen

• Verwaltung und Pflege der Teilnehmerstammdaten

• Koordination mit der Schweizerischen Nationalbank sowie der Swiss Euro Clearing Bank

• Teilnahme an fachspezifischen Notfallübungen sowie Mitarbeit in Projekten

• Verschiedene administrative Arbeiten

Das bringst du mit

• Kaufmännische Grundausbildung (Kaufmännische Berufslehre, Handelsschule oder gleichwertige Ausbildung), Erfahrung im Zahlungsverkehr von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (Montag bis Freitag: Zwischen 06.30 – 19.30 Uhr)

• Nach ca. 1 Jahr: Bereitschaft für Pikettdienst ausserhalb der Bürozeiten inkl. Wochenende/Feiertage

• Ein hohes Mass an Selbstständigkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft

• Teamplayer und Freude am Kundenkontakt

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio etc.)

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Französischkenntnisse ist ein Plus

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Observability Engineer

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7664

The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role focused on building and delivering observability and AIOps as a shared engineering capability and service. You will help establish how observability is designed, implemented, and consumed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into actionable observability solutions, implement and operate core capabilities, and continuously improve how insights, alerting, and automation support reliable services. As a core contributor to the Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence, you will combine deep technical execution with strong ownership of service quality, operational readiness, and capability maturity

What You Will Do

• design, deploy, and operate observability and AIOps capabilities for cloud-native and hybrid environments, supporting reliable, production-grade services

• lead the onboarding of teams and services, defining and applying standards for telemetry instrumentation, collection, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting in real-world systems using OpenTelemetry

• work hands-on with engineering, SRE, and operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into actionable observability and automation solutions

• install, configure, fine-tune, and maintain OpenTelemetry Collectors and telemetry pipelines for applications and platforms

• build and maintain dashboards, alerting, and telemetry flows across distributed tracing, metrics, and logs, leveraging OpenTelemetry to deliver meaningful insights and reduce operational noise

• run and evolve observability services that support modern incident detection, investigation, and operational decision-making

• design, configure, and maintain integrations with event management and ticketing systems for alert routing, incident context, and operational workflows

What You Bring

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in observability, SRE, platform, or reliability engineering, including responsibility for production observability capabilities

• proven experience taking observability capabilities from requirements to production-ready solutions; experience limited to dashboards, queries, or observability backends as a consumer is not sufficient

• practical experience instrumenting applications and infrastructure with OpenTelemetry to generate traces, metrics, and logs

• strong understanding of modern, trace-centric observability practices beyond traditional log-centric monitoring

• experience deploying, configuring, and operating OpenTelemetry Collectors and designing telemetry pipelines is a strong advantage; these will be key hands-on responsibilities in the role

• experience with cloud-native environments, operating Kubernetes-based workloads

• experience with common observability toolchains and backends (e.g.: Elastic, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, etc.) - Elastic Stack experience considered a plus

• scripting or automation skills to support repeatable deployment, configuration, validation, and ongoing operations using technologies such as Helm, Terraform, and Ansible

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
